text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I can't believe you got so many! True to their name, they're all so cute.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I gotta say, your claw maneuvering skills are anything but ordinary. You're like a pro!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It might be easier if I ask you to get that stuffed spider for me… Okay, let's go give it a shot!
